description: This Java source file defines the HonoBasicAuthHandler class, which extends Vert.x's BasicAuthHandlerImpl. It customizes authentication handling, particularly for exceptions and credential parsing, in the context of the Eclipse Hono project. The class incorporates tracing support via OpenTracing and manages HTTP response behaviors during authentication failures.

classes.name: HonoBasicAuthHandler
classes.description: A custom authentication handler extending Vert.x's BasicAuthHandlerImpl, integrated with Hono-specific exception processing and tracing functionality.

methods.name: HonoBasicAuthHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with an auth provider, realm, and tracer.

methods.name: processException
methods.description: Overrides the method to handle exceptions, ensuring response is not already ended and delegating to a utility for processing.

methods.name: parseCredentials
methods.description: Overrides the credential parsing to handle malformed headers gracefully and injects tracing span context if available.
